VIETNAM VISA FOR INDIANS (2026)
Mainland Vietnam (Hanoi · Da Nang · Ho Chi Minh) needs an e-visa: USD 25 single-entry / USD 50 multiple-entry, valid up to 90 days.

Apply ONLY on the official portal: https://evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn 
(processing 3–5 working days — apply 7–10 days ahead, passport valid 6+ months with 2 blank pages, carry a printed copy).

THE PHU QUOC VISA-FREE TRAP
Phu Quoc gives Indians a 30-day VISA-FREE stay — but ONLY if you fly in directly from abroad (via Bangkok / Kuala Lumpur) AND it is your only stop in Vietnam. The moment you transit Ho Chi Minh or Hanoi, that visa-free status is VOID and you need the e-visa. Doing a multi-city trip? Just get the e-visa — it's simpler and covers everything (a single-entry e-visa covers domestic flights inside Vietnam).

SKIP THE 2-HOUR IMMIGRATION QUEUE
Immigration can take up to 2 hours. A fast-track service meets you at the aerobridge, walks you through a priority lane, grabs your bags and loads your taxi — usually under 20 minutes. Book for your landing airport:
